about_the_game:
WELCOME TO THE OUTBACK

Welcome to the stunning Outback of Northern Australia, as beautiful and full of life as it is deadly. Get ready to experience the highs and lows of building a Northern Australian cattle station. 

Use true to life tools of Aussie ringers to build your own Cattle Station. Head in on horse with your dog at your side for a traditional ranching experience. Or grab the helicopter, send up the drones and drift the bull catcher through paddocks to master modern cattle ranching.

TOOLS OF THE TRADE

Master the tried and tested tools of Australian Cattle ranchers: 

  • Drive Utes & Buggy's Off-Road

  • Play as an Australian Cattle Dog

  • Fly Helicopters for a Birds Eye View

  • Ride Horses like authentic Jackaroos and Jillaroos

  • And bring your herd home in Authentic Road Trains

BUILD YOUR OWN CATTLE STATION

An homage to those who live and breathe the most challenging and exciting farming lifestyle in the world, you’ll need to battle the weather, markets, and mother nature herself to come out on top as you and your mates build your own Cattle Station.

Pasture is our best effort to capture the everyday lives of Australian cattle ranchers, built by the Salty Games crew from across Australia.
detailed_description:
Community

JOIN THE PASTURE COMMUNITY

Get stuck in with other ranchers, lend a hand and find a mate or three to tackle whatever the Outback throws your way!  Join the Salty Games Discord through the link in the side bar.

Hear from real world Cattle Station workers, connect with the Salty Games crew, and be a part of building Pasture.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 3 GHZ with Turbo Boost
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650 or equivalent
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • VR Support: N/A
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 3.5 GHZ with Turbo boost
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 3060 or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: N/A

short_description: An action-farming ranch simulator set in the Australian Outback. Saddle up for a solo adventure, or grab a mate and spin up the helicopter to move thousands of cattle together.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Polish, Simplified Chinese
